title: Channing Tatum Denies Using Instagram Burner Account to Troll Ex Zoë Kravitz, Harry Styles: ‘WTF Come On’
summary: "I truly can't believe y'all think this is what I'm doing with my free time," the actor wrote.
contentText:
Channing Tatum would like to make one thing clear: He is not spending his free time anonymously commenting on his ex-fianceé Zoë Kravitz and her new love, Harry Styles .

Related

The actor addressed the bizarre social media theory Monday (Sept. 21) after an Instagram account called @bidness_nonya became the main subject of online speculation. The account had been leaving comments about Kravitz and Styles, and had Tatum as the sole follower. This prompted fans to wonder whether the Magic Mike star was secretly the face behind the page.

Tatum, however, insists that isn’t the case.

“Yo I truly can’t believe y’all think this is what I’m doing with my free time,” he wrote on his Instagram Story, calling the speculation “f–kin hilarious.” He also questioned why he would publicly follow an account if he were actually trying to conceal his identity before adding, “Wtf cmon. I only have one IG account @channingtatum.”

The theory began after users noticed the account was commenting on posts involving Kravitz and Styles, including one showing PDA between the couple. One comment, according to screenshots circulating online, read, “Just here for the hate,” while other posts were taking digs at Kravitz and Tatum’s other past relationships.

The account has since gone inactive or been deleted, and there is no confirmation that Tatum was ever even behind it.

Tatum and Kravitz previously dated, beginning in 2021 and became engaged in 2023 before ending their relationship in October 2024. Kravitz and Styles sparked dating rumors when they appeared together in 2025. The actress sported a giant diamond ring on her finger in April 2026, leading to reports that the pair was engaged, though neither one has confirmed.

Styles is currently on his Together, Together residency tour. The trek supports his fourth studio album, Kiss All the Time. Disco, Occasionally , a project that gave the singer a fourth No. 1 on the Billboard 200 upon its release. The Together, Together run includes 30 shows at New York’s Madison Square Garden before continuing to additional stadium dates in North America and Europe.

Kravitz also has several projects on the horizon, while Tatum is set to star in Josephine , due in theaters Nov. 20.
